teaser.en: A small weed farmers are happy to see: where it grows, the harvest will be good.
teaser.sw: Gugu dogo ambalo wakulima hufurahi kuliona: linapoota, mavuno yatakuwa mazuri.
teaser.dg: Mbondo mdide ambao akurima nkuhererwa kuuona: phatu unaphomera, mavuno gandakala manono.

summary.en: *Chimvuno* is a *Leucas*, a small mint-family herb. Digo farmers read it as a sign that their crop will do well.
summary.sw: *Chimvuno* ni *Leucas*, mmea mdogo wa familia ya minanaa. Wakulima wa Kidigo hukiona kuwa ishara kwamba mazao yao yatastawi.
summary.dg: *Chimvuno* ni *Leucas*, mmea mdide wa jamii ya *mint*. Akurima Adigo anauona dza dalili kukala mimea yao indamera vinono.

about.en: *Leucas* species are herbs of the mint family with square stems, opposite leaves and white, two-lipped flowers whose upper lip is densely hairy. The flowers grow in round whorls spaced along the stem. Pakia identified *chimvuno* only to the genus, so the exact species isn't known.
about.sw: Spishi za *Leucas* ni mimea midogo ya familia ya minanaa yenye mashina ya pembe nne, majani yanayoelekeana na maua meupe yenye midomo miwili, ambayo mdomo wake wa juu una manyoya mengi. Maua huota katika duara za mviringo zilizoachana kando ya shina. Pakia alikitambua *chimvuno* hadi kiwango cha jenasi tu, kwa hiyo spishi yake kamili haijulikani.
about.dg: Aina za *Leucas* ni mimea midide ya jamii ya *mint*, yenye milita ya pembe nne, makodza ganayolengana, na maruwa mereru genye miromo miiri, ambago mromo wa dzulu una nyere nyinji sana. Maruwa ganamera kpwa mafungu ga duara ganayozunguluka mlita, ganayotengana kulunga mlita. Pakia akamanya *chimvuno* hadi jenasi tu, kpwa hivyo aina kamili taimanyikana.

where.en: *Leucas* species are common in farmland, fallow fields and grassland across East Africa.
where.sw: Spishi za *Leucas* ni za kawaida mashambani, katika mashamba yaliyoachwa kupumzika na nyika za nyasi kote Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Aina za *Leucas* ni za kawaida mindani, kpwenye minda iriyorichwa bila kurimwa, na kpwenye nyasi kpwa Afrika ya Mashariki yosi.

culture.en: Pakia records that when this plant appears, it shows that the crop will do well and there will be plenty to eat. It is one of the weeds that Digo farmers read as a sign of how fertile the land is. By contrast, *chitsai* (witchweed) and *luswi* are taken as signs of poor harvests.
culture.sw: Pakia ameandika kwamba mmea huu unapotokea, unaonyesha kwamba mazao yatastawi na kutakuwa na chakula tele. Ni mojawapo ya magugu ambayo wakulima wa Kidigo huyasoma kama ishara ya rutuba ya ardhi. Kinyume chake, *chitsai* (kiduha) na *luswi* huchukuliwa kuwa ishara za mavuno duni.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala mmea uhu uchizuka, unaonyesa kukala mimea indamera vinono na kundakala na chakurya chinji. Ni mwenga wa mbondo ambazo akurima Adigo anazilola dza dalili ya chinemi cha tsi. Tafwauti na hivyo, *chitsai* (kpwa Chingereza *witchweed*) na *luswi* nkuonekana dza dalili za mavuno machache.

names.en: *Chimvuno* refers to a full stomach: Pakia translates it as 'stomach full', linking it to *mvuno*, the satisfaction of having enough food. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: *Chimvuno* linarejelea tumbo lililoshiba: Pakia analitafsiri kama 'tumbo limejaa', akilihusisha na *mvuno*, kuridhika kwa kuwa na chakula cha kutosha. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: *Chimvuno* rinahusu tumbo ririrodzala: Pakia anaeleza manage dza 'tumbo ririrodzala', na anarihusisha na *mvuno*, kumvuna kpwa kuphaha chakurya cha kukola. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: Itch grass, a weed of poor fields
reason.sw: Nyasi inayowasha (itch grass), gugu la mashamba duni
reason.dg: *Itch grass*, mbondo wanjina wa minda isiyo na chinemi

reason.en: Guinea grass, a sign of fertile soil
reason.sw: Nyasi ya Guinea (Guinea grass), ishara ya udongo wenye rutuba
reason.dg: *Guinea grass*, dalili ya tsi yenye chinemi

reason.en: Thatching grass, a sign of fertile soil
reason.sw: Nyasi ya kuezekea, ishara ya udongo wenye rutuba
reason.dg: Nyasi za kuezekera nyumba, dalili ya tsi yenye chinemi
